parsed.name: quality_momentum_global
parsed.strategy: Buy liquid global quality-momentum: names with positive 90-day net analyst raises, 6-12 month price momentum, and flat-to-rising gross margins (NVDA, TSM, MU, AMD, AVGO, ASML, AMGN, LLY, ABBV, MRK, GEV, NVT, WST, ARGX, OKTA, SNOW, CRWD, PANW, DELL, AMKR, COGT, BBIO, SVRA). Avoid names far above their 200-day with falling margins and negative revision flow (ALB, VRT, CEG, LEU, SMR, FLUT, NVO, PFE). I would be wrong if a single AI-capex digestion headline or a broad Q3 earnings miss hits the semis/power cluster simultaneously, or if the small-cap PDUFA names (COGT, BBIO, SVRA) return CRLs and the CRL tail overwhelms the book.
parsed.objective: Beat the Bloomberg WLS index on relative P&L from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a long-only quality-momentum book.
